title: 第14章 苏家午饭和一个电话
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
苏念念家在城中心一条安静的巷子里，两层小楼，门口种着一棵桂花树，这个季节刚好飘出若有若无的桂花香。

    安槐对这条路太熟了，闭着眼睛都能走到，从巷口数第七家，蓝色的铁门，门上贴着一张褪色的春联。

    苏念念推门进去，扬着嗓子喊了一声。

    “妈，我回来了，安槐也来了！”

    厨房里传来苏念念妈妈温柔的声音。

    “回来了？洗手准备吃饭，汤快好了。”

    安槐跟在苏念念身后进了门，换了拖鞋。客厅沙发上，苏正川正坐着看一份武道期刊，一脸严肃，看到安槐进来，他放下期刊，面无表情地点了一下头。

    “来了。”

    “苏叔叔好。”安槐微微鞠躬。

    苏正川嗯了一声，目光在安槐身上停留了两秒，像是在用眼神扫描他的修为。

    “听方远说你摸底测试综合第一。”

    “运气好。”

    苏正川的嘴角微微动了一下，安槐看不出是认可还是别的什么，总之那张国字脸上的表情变化幅度从来不超过三毫米。

    苏念念从卫生间洗完手出来，头发末端还沾着水。

    “爸，你又审问人家呢？”

    “我没有。”

    “你那个表情就叫审问。”

    苏正川张了张嘴，最终选择了沉默，重新拿起期刊。

    安槐在餐桌旁坐下，苏念念的妈妈端着一锅莲藕排骨汤从厨房出来。

    苏念念的妈妈姓陈，叫陈婉清，长得很温柔，说话慢悠悠的，笑起来眼角会弯成好看的弧度。

    苏念念的五官随了她妈，但性格走了完全相反的路。

    “安槐，瘦了。”陈婉清把一碗汤放到安槐面前，“最近是不是没好好吃饭？”

    “有在吃的，阿姨。”

    “食堂的东西能吃饱吗？以后周末都来家里吃。”

    “谢谢阿姨。”

    苏念念在旁边翻了个白眼。

    “妈，你对他比对我还好。”

    “你又不瘦。”

    苏念念低头看了看自己的肚子。

    “我也不胖吧？”

    “你的胖和安槐的瘦不是一个概念，别转移话题，吃饭。”

    苏念念撇了撇嘴，闷头喝汤。

    安槐坐在苏念念对面，喝了一口排骨汤，味道一如既往地好，陈阿姨的手艺在这条巷子里是出了名的，安槐从小喝到大，喝了十年。

    苏正川沉默地坐到主位上，开始吃饭。一家三口加一个安槐，餐桌上的气氛温馨而热闹，主要是苏念念和她妈在说话，苏正川负责低头吃饭，安槐负责安静听着偶尔点头。

    “妈，学校的灵气感知课安槐拿了紫色。”

    陈婉清惊讶地看了安槐一眼。

    “紫色？那很好了，你呢？”

    “我上品蓝。”

    “也不错嘛。”

    苏正川闷声说了一句：“上品蓝在苏家历代子弟中排前三。”

    苏念念怔了一下，随即露出一个有点不好意思的笑。

    “真的？爸你怎么从来没说过？”

    “你没问。”
content_en:
Su Niannian's house is a two-story building in a quiet alley in the center of the city. There is an osmanthus tree planted at the door. This season, the faint fragrance of osmanthus is wafting out.

An Huai was so familiar with this road that he could walk there with his eyes closed. The seventh house from the alley entrance had a blue iron gate with a faded Spring Festival couplet on it.

Su Niannian pushed the door open and shouted with a raised voice.

"Mom, I'm back, and An Huai is here too!"

Su Niannian's mother's gentle voice came from the kitchen.

"You're back? Wash your hands and get ready to eat. The soup is almost ready."

An Huai followed Su Niannian through the door and changed into slippers.On the sofa in the living room, Su Zhengchuan was sitting and reading a martial arts journal with a serious look on his face. When he saw An Huai come in, he put down the journal and nodded expressionlessly.

"Coming."

"Hello, Uncle Su." An Huai bowed slightly.

Su Zhengchuan hummed and his eyes stayed on An Huai for two seconds, as if scanning his cultivation with his eyes.

"I heard from Fang Yuan that you ranked first overall in the basic test."

"Good luck."

The corner of Su Zhengchuan's mouth moved slightly. An Huai couldn't tell whether it was recognition or something else. In short, the expression on the Chinese-character face never changed by more than three millimeters.

Su Niannian came out of the bathroom after washing her hands, the ends of her hair still stained with water.

"Dad, are you interrogating someone again?"

"I didn't."

"That expression of yours is called interrogation."

Su Zhengchuan opened his mouth, but finally chose silence and picked up the journal again.

An Huai sat down at the dining table, and Su Niannian's mother came out of the kitchen with a pot of lotus root and pork ribs soup.

Su Niannian's mother's surname is Chen Wanqing. She looks very gentle, speaks slowly, and the corners of her eyes will curve into nice curves when she smiles.

Su Niannian's facial features took after her mother's, but her personality took a completely opposite path.

"An Huai, you've lost weight." Chen Wanqing put a bowl of soup in front of An Huai, "Have you not eaten well recently?"

"There is something to eat, Auntie."

"Can the food in the cafeteria satisfy you? From now on, you will come to eat at home on weekends."

"Thank you, aunt."

Su Niannian rolled her eyes at the side.

"Mom, you treat him better than you treat me."

"You're not thin."

Su Niannian looked down at her belly.

"I'm not fat either, am I?"

"Your fatness and An Huai's thinness are not the same thing. Don't change the subject and eat."

Su Niannian curled her lips and drank the soup.

An Huai sat opposite Su Niannian and took a sip of the pork rib soup. The taste was as good as ever. Aunt Chen's craftsmanship was famous in this alley. An Huai had been drinking it for ten years since he was a child.

Su Zhengchuan sat down at the main seat in silence and began to eat.There was a family of three plus An Huai, and the atmosphere at the dining table was warm and lively. Su Niannian and her mother were mainly talking. Su Zhengchuan was responsible for eating with his head down, and An Huai was responsible for listening quietly and nodding occasionally.

"Mom, An Huai took purple in the school's aura perception class."

Chen Wanqing glanced at An Huai in surprise.

"Purple? That's great, what about you?"

"My royal blue."

"It's not bad."

Su Zhengchuan said in a low voice: "Shangpinlan ranks among the top three in the Su family's history."

Su Niannian was startled for a moment, then smiled a little sheepishly.

"Really? Dad, why have you never said that?"

"You didn't ask."
title_en: Chapter 14 Lunch and a phone call at the Su family
